text:
Samir Patel: Async status check — Northshore private rollout (VPC / air-gapped). Pushing staging canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final owners for egress NAT, cert rotation, and image sync. Current blockers: 1) image repo sync failing (403 from airgap-proxy) 2) egress CIDR not confirmed 3) Vault cert role missing. Who can own each?

Jules Kim: I can own image sync. I saw a 403 in the proxy logs: 
```
GET /v2/_catalog 403 "access denied: token not authorized"
```
Likely token scope or the proxy ACLs. I'll start with token check + proxy ACLs.

Priya Rao: I'll take cert rotation + Vault role. Which service account are we using for the cert-rotator in Northshore? @Samir

Samir Patel: Service account is northshore-cert-rotator@redwood-inference-prod. Priya, ping me if you need a quick IAM grant.

Jules Kim: Starting token repro now. If token is fine, next is to confirm the airgap-proxy trusts the image registry CA. Might need a cert bundle pushed to the proxy.

Marta Chen: Egress CIDR from customer doc is 18.45.0.0/16 but I haven't gotten final sign-off from NetOps. I'll chase the customer and NetOps today.

Theo Alvarez: FYI ops schedule: oncall for the canary window is me (09:00–13:00 PT). I can take initial smoke and followups.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: northshore-staging v2026-04-01-09:00 (auto). Notified: @Theo.

Jules Kim: Quick notes on debugging the 403: tried curl against proxy with same token, got same 403. Command used: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://airgap-proxy.northshore.internal/v2/_catalog
```
Response headers include X-Proxy-ACL: registry-read-only. Means allowed but token unknown. Going to verify token issuer and audience.

Priya Rao: For Vault role: looks like the role northshore-cert-role is missing the allowed_entity for the cert-rotator SA. I'll open a Vault PR unless someone else already has it.

Marta Chen: Quick ask — if customer doesn't confirm 18.45/16 by EOD, do we have fallback egress via shared-bastion? That needs a small routing change.

Samir Patel: We have shared-bastion fallback but it's higher latency and requires a routing ACL. Not preferred but acceptable as contingency. Can we get a decision by 17:00 PT?

Theo Alvarez: I can enable fallback during the window if Marta gives the +1. I'll also run smoke tests: http health, token pull, and image pull test. Test commands I'll run: 
```
# image pull smoke
sudo -u redwood-runner docker pull staging-registry.northshore/app:canary
curl -sSf https://10.0.12.4:8443/health || echo "health fail"
```

Jules Kim: If proxy refuses even with correct token, likely ACL needs explicit registry path allow. I'll prepare a short ACL diff and post it here for review.

Priya Rao: PR opened: https://git.internal/rf/vault-configs/pulls/117 — adds northshore-cert-role bindings. PTAL @Samir @Marta.

Marta Chen: Reviewing PR now, will aim to approve by 15:30 PT. Also emailing customer for CIDR confirm.

Theo Alvarez: Code review ping: PR #4123 (egress fallback routing) needs an approver. @Marta can you take a look after the Vault PR?

Marta Chen: Yep, will review #4123 after vault PR. If both green we can rely on primary egress.

Samir Patel: Updated ownership list for cutover: image sync = Jules, certs/Vault = Priya, egress ownership = Marta, oncall/smoke = Theo. Timeline: smoke start 09:00 PT, quick verification 09:30 PT, cutover 13:00 PT. Please react with :thumbsup: if you confirm.

Jules Kim: :thumbsup: I will post proxy ACL diff by 14:00 PT.

Priya Rao: :thumbsup: I merged the Vault PR (will send deploy runbook step).

Marta Chen: :thumbsup: CIDR confirmed by customer (18.45.0.0/16). Approving #4123 now.

Theo Alvarez: All set on my side. I'll run the smoke checklist at 09:00. If anything flaps I'll escalate here and call the cutover hold.

Samir Patel: Thanks all — will send the final runbook + checklist in about 30m. If anything changes before the window please update this thread. :crossed_fingers:
